from pptx import Presentation

out_path = r'C:\Users\016551\OneDrive\Desktop\流程建设\复盘策略库\tools\nt_raw_extract.md'

prs = Presentation(path)

lines = []
lines.append(f"# OpenFit Pro (NT) 北美上市复盘 - PPTX 原始提取\n")
lines.append(f"共 {len(prs.slides)} 页\n")

for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    lines.append(f"\n---\n\n## Slide {i+1}\n")
    
    if slide.shapes.title:
        lines.append(f"**标题**: {slide.shapes.title.text}\n")
    
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            for para in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                text = para.text.strip()
                if text:
                    lines.append(text)
            lines.append("")
        
        if shape.has_table:
            table = shape.table
            lines.append("")
            header_cells = []
            for cell in table.rows[0].cells:

            lines.append("| " + " | ".join(header_cells) + " |")
            lines.append("| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(header_cells)) + " |")
            for row_idx, row in enumerate(table.rows):
                if row_idx == 0:
                    continue
                cells = []
                for cell in row.cells:
                    cells.append(cell.text.strip().replace('\n', ' '))
                lines.append("| " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
            lines.append("")

with open(out_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(lines))

print(f"Done. Output: {out_path}")

---

## 一、项目概况

### 战略目标

- 2026年北美销量34万台（700M），提拉耳挂线销量，亚马逊评分＞4.3
